remarks: This beautifully renovated farmhouse, set on just under a half-acre, seamlessly blends timeless charm with modern updates and exceptional indoor-outdoor living.  Inside, a spacious living room showcases white oak flooring that flows effortlessly throughout. The dining area opens into an updated kitchen, complete with a large island, stainless steel appliances, and quartz countertops-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The stunning family room is a true centerpiece, featuring vaulted ceilings and dramatic floor-to-ceiling windows that frame breathtaking sunset views. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a peaceful retreat with a walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bathroom designed for ultimate relaxation. Two additional generously sized bedrooms share a beautifully appointed hall bath. The finished lower level adds versatility, complete with a newly renovated full bathroom-ideal for a home gym, playroom, or guest/in-law suite. Outside, the fully fenced backyard provides exceptional privacy, bordered by a charming stone wall, cedar fencing, and the scenic Devils Garden Open Space. Designed with entertaining in mind, the outdoor space features a covered deck, a stone patio with a fire pit, and an irrigation system. All of this is just a short walk to the Rowayton train station, Pinkney Park, and the charming shops and dining that make Rowayton such a special place to live.
